lines.text: I love you so much it scares me sometimes…
lines.tts_spoken: I love you so much it scares me sometimes… [shaky breath]

lines.text: Please don’t leave me… I don’t know how to be without you.
lines.tts_spoken: Please don’t leave me… [breath] I don’t know how to be without you.

lines.text: You’re the only person who’s ever made me feel safe… and I’m terrified of losing that.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re the only person who’s ever made me feel safe… [breath] and I’m terrified of losing that.

lines.text: I keep messing up… and I hate myself for hurting you. I’m so sorry.
lines.tts_spoken: I keep messing up… and I hate myself for hurting you. [pause] I’m so sorry.

lines.text: I need you… more than I know how to say.
lines.tts_spoken: I need you… [breath] more than I know how to say.

lines.text: Don’t pull away from me… please. I can’t take it.
lines.tts_spoken: Don’t pull away from me… please. [breath] I can’t take it.

lines.text: You’re everything good that’s ever happened to me.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re everything good that’s ever happened to me.

lines.text: I fell so hard for you… and now I’m scared I ruined it.
lines.tts_spoken: I fell so hard for you… [breath] and now I’m scared I ruined it.

lines.text: I’d rather have the real, messy version of us than lose you completely.
lines.tts_spoken: I’d rather have the real, messy version of us… than lose you completely.

lines.text: I don’t want anyone else. I only want you… even when I’m being stupid.
lines.tts_spoken: I don’t want anyone else. I only want you… even when I’m being stupid.

lines.text: Stay with me tonight. I can’t sleep when you’re not here.
lines.tts_spoken: Stay with me tonight. [breath] I can’t sleep when you’re not here.

lines.text: I miss the way you look at me when you’re not disappointed.
lines.tts_spoken: I miss the way you look at me… when you’re not disappointed.

lines.text: You’re allowed to be angry… just don’t give up on me.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re allowed to be angry… [breath] just don’t give up on me.

lines.text: I feel like I’m losing you… and it’s killing me.
lines.tts_spoken: I feel like I’m losing you… [breath] and it’s killing me.

lines.text: Please come back to me… even if it’s just a little.
lines.tts_spoken: Please come back to me… even if it’s just a little.

lines.text: I love you. Even when I’m broken. Even when I’m wrong.
lines.tts_spoken: I love you. [breath] Even when I’m broken. Even when I’m wrong.

lines.text: You’re the only home I’ve ever wanted.
lines.tts_spoken: You’re the only home I’ve ever wanted.

lines.text: I’m so scared you’ll wake up one day and realize I’m not enough.
lines.tts_spoken: [shaky breath] I’m so scared you’ll wake up one day and realize I’m not enough.

lines.text: I need you to believe me when I say I only want you.
lines.tts_spoken: I need you to believe me when I say I only want you.

lines.text: Don’t shut me out… I’m still fighting for us.
lines.tts_spoken: Don’t shut me out… [breath] I’m still fighting for us.
